name: curl-safari
description: Use curl with your existing Safari login.

interface.shortDescription: Use curl with your existing Safari login
interface.longDescription: Run ordinary curl commands against pages where you are already logged in through Safari. curl-safari automatically supplies matching Safari cookies while passing normal curl arguments through unchanged, without giving Codex direct Full Disk Access.
defaultPrompt: Use curl with my existing Safari login to fetch this page.
Use curl-safari to inspect this page where I am already logged in through Safari.
Use curl-safari to check whether my existing Safari login works with this API.
